title: Operate monitoring, detection, and alert triage: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: When should a signal be escalated, suppressed, or used to tune detection?
focalInsight: Definitions, decision owner/criterion, failure consequence, and retrieval remain distinct.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Detection Use Case
nodes.definition: Use case: owned question with data/threshold/playbook
nodes.detail: Use case: owned question with data/threshold/playbook

altSummary: Definitions, decision owner/criterion, failure consequence, and retrieval remain distinct.
textFallback:
idps: IDPS: observes/prevents at points. Decision: decide enforcement/observation placement.. Failure/example: blind lateral path.
siem: SIEM: aggregates/correlates multi-source events. Decision: decide source quality/use cases.. Failure/example: correlation on missing identity.
continuous monitoring: Continuous monitoring: recurring control/risk signals. Decision: decide reassessment trigger.. Failure/example: drift persists after audit.
alert triage: Triage: assess confidence/impact/context. Decision: decide escalation/closure evidence.. Failure/example: noisy rule hides incident.
detection use case: Use case: owned question with data/threshold/playbook. Decision: decide coverage.. Failure/example: alert has no response path.
threshold tuning: Tuning: change threshold from outcomes. Decision: decide precision/recall tradeoff.. Failure/example: lowers noise and misses attack.
threat intelligence: Intelligence: contextual actors/indicators/TTPs. Decision: decide relevance/age/confidence.. Failure/example: stale IOC blocks business.
threat hunting: Hunting: hypothesis-led telemetry search. Decision: decide question/evidence.. Failure/example: feed lookup called hunt.
ueba: UEBA: entity behavior baseline. Decision: decide baseline bias/exception review.. Failure/example: privileged anomaly normalized.
